contract.name: The disappearing order
contract.description: A checkout release adds order status. Forward tests pass. The rollback restores a pre-release snapshot — silently erasing orders placed after deployment.
contract.upSql: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending';

SELECT 1;
